title: Masjidly
subtitle: Prayer Time Display & Announcements
overview: Masjidly is a purpose-built prayer time display and announcement system for masajid — a Vue.js display app backed by a Strapi CMS so committee members can manage timetables, event posters, and branding from any browser, with content syncing to TV screens and mobile.
challenge: Most masajid run on volunteer committees without IT support. They needed a reliable way to show accurate salah times and rotating event announcements on wall-mounted TVs — without PowerPoint slides, USB drives, or someone on call to fix the screen.
solution: Built a Vue 3 display renderer with a 40/60 TV-optimised layout, a Strapi v5 headless CMS for non-technical admins, and flexible deployment options — cloud-hosted, self-hosted via Docker, or a plug-and-play player device — so each masjid can run the system the way that fits them.

sections.title: The display
sections.content: The front-end is a single-page Vue 3 app designed for wall-mounted TVs: prayer times on the left, rotating announcement posters on the right. The layout highlights the next salah throughout the day, supports Jummah rows, and stays readable from across a large prayer hall.

sections.title: CMS & content pipeline
sections.content: Admins upload yearly timetables as CSV or JSON, publish event posters with expiry dates, and configure masjid branding — logo, name, and theme colour — through a straightforward Strapi dashboard. Announcements auto-expire via scheduled jobs, so outdated notices never linger on screen.

sections.title: Deployment options
sections.content: Masjidly ships three ways: cloud-hosted on Railway and Netlify for fully managed operation, self-hosted via Docker for offline-first local networks, or a preconfigured Player device that plugs into a TV and goes live in minutes. Each path shares the same CMS and display experience.

sections.title: Marketing site
sections.content: A separate Vue 3 + Vite marketing SPA explains features, deployment tiers, and pricing to masjid committees, with onboarding enquiries handled through Netlify serverless functions and email delivery.
